newsitem.title: SPAIN: Prosegur shares tumble in bourse.
newsitem.headline: Prosegur shares tumble in bourse.

text.p: Shares in Spanish insurer Prosegur tumbled in trade on Monday, hurt by news of the death of its chairman in a traffic accident on Sarturday.
"News of this type always prompts tumult, but the truth is that the share is being dominated by put-throughs which distorts its price," a dealer said.
A spokesman for Prosegur said business management was ensured by an eight-member committee designated by the board.
At 1020 GMT, shares in the group were down 100 points, or 5.31 percent, to 1,785, while the IBEX-35 index of leading shares was down 66.46 points or 1.05 percent, at 6,235.63.
